name: doc-workflow
description: Improve a document until it passes readability, section, and word-count checks.
fixPrompt:
The document at {{docWorkflow.targetFile}} failed one or more quality checks (see output above).

For each failing check:
- readability: Rewrite long or complex sentences. Prefer short sentences (≤ 20 words), plain words, and active voice. Target Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease ≥ 60.
- required-section: Add the missing section heading and a meaningful paragraph under it.
- word-count-total: Expand or trim the document to meet the word count range.
- section-word-count: Expand or trim the named section to meet its word count range.

Edit only the document file. Do not change verifier thresholds or configuration to make the check pass.
guardrails: Never lower minScore, minWords, maxWords, or any threshold in harness.config.json to converge.
Never add placeholder or filler text (e.g. 'Lorem ipsum') to inflate word count.
Never remove required sections — add them if missing.
Only edit the document being verified — do not touch other files.
onExhausted: Stop. Report each failing check verbatim, what was attempted in each iteration, and which checks remain red. Do not retry.
